fact: SMART Zambia Institute says it has developed the Citizens Support Services Portal, taking complaints with a tracking number through portal, SMS, WhatsApp, app and chatbot channels, with the official launch date still to be announced.

The government told the World Bank's GovTech survey (2025) that Zambia has a government platform for citizen feedback on service delivery, linking the Citizens Support Services portal; as_of is the survey round's year.
